source_title: Cash Recovery: Police Dig Up Three Drums of Hidden Cash in Prayagraj
source_excerpt:
Police in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, have reportedly recovered a large amount of cash hidden underground during a raid in the Nawabganj police station area. Acting on a confidential tip-off, a police team searched a property in Baraiypur Ramnagar village, where officers dug up the ground inside a house compound and discovered three drums buried beneath the soil. The drums contained a substantial quantity of cash, including bundles of ₹500 notes. Police seized the money, sealed the recovered cash and took it into their custody. Two individuals, identified as Rajesh Yadav and Rakesh Yadav, have been detained in connection with the case. Given the scale of the recovery, the police immediately informed the relevant departments. The counting of the seized currency was underway in the presence of police personnel, and further legal proceedings were continuing at the time of the report. The exact amount of cash recovered and its source had not yet been officially established in the information provided. Investigators are expected to examine the circumstances surrounding the hidden money and determine who it belonged to and why it was buried underground.
